data.name: Cassi
data.gender_notes: Cassi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Kassandra', which means 'pure, innocent, or temple'. In Greek mythology, Cassandra was a prophetess who was granted the gift of prophecy but cursed to never be believed. Despite this, her name remained a symbol of purity and divine inspiration. The name Cassi carries the meaning “Pure, innocent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cassi usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine inspiration and purity
data.etymology: Cassi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, innocent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cassi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: קאסי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קאסי מקורו מהמילה הקסיה, שמקורה ביוונית ומשמעותה שופטת, נקיה, צדק. השם קאסי משמש כנראה כצורה נגזרת של השם קסיה, שמוזכר בכתבי הקודש כדמות נוצרית מוקדמת.

in_greek.name: Κάсси
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κάсси προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη καθαρός, δίκαιος. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Κασσία αναφέρεται ως μία χριστιανή που ακολουθούσε το δρόμο του Κυρίου.

in_latin.name: Cassi
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Cassi originates from the Latin term 'cassus,' meaning pure, clear, just. In early Christian tradition, Cassi was used as a diminutive form of names starting with 'Cass,' signifying spiritual clarity and moral purity.

in_english.name: Cassi
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cassi is derived from Greek and Latin roots, meaning pure, clear, or just. It is associated with early Christian tradition, symbolizing spiritual clarity and moral purity. The name Cassi may be a variant of Cassia, mentioned in Christian scripture as a devoted follower.

data.cultural_impact: In Christianity, many saints have been given the name Cassia or Cassandra, reflecting the association with the Greek mythological figure and her symbolic purity. The name carries the cultural weight of the ancient prophetess, representing the idea of women who possess a deep spiritual gift and the courage to use it, even when not believed by others.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Cassi holds significant spiritual meaning as it is rooted in the Greek name 'Kassandra', which represents purity, innocence, and the temple - a sacred and consecrated space. For Christians, this name would be seen as a reminder of their relationship with God and their dedication to serving Him in a pure and unwavering way. It can also symbolize the idea of carrying a gift or message (such as a prophecy) from God and remaining steadfast in sharing it, even in the face of skepticism or disbelief.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cassia is a name derived from the ancient tree bearing sweet-smelling yellow-orbed flowers. In Christianity, it symbolizes endurance and strength, as the Cassia tree stands firm against life's trials, its fragrant blossoms a reminder of the sweet rewards that come from persevering through hardship.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Cassi, a minister in New York, United States, shares that their name Cassi meaning "Pure, innocent" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
